_comment: HUMAN LINE JOINT PAY (MTG_HUMAN_LINE_JOINT_PAY; Morph INT-14; USER 2026-11-13: "our mana handling should be smart
enough to address shortfalls in part of the plan"). Den Protector's flip {1}{G} queued FIRST, then Might of Old Krosa x2
